Description: Found a Stripe Access Token, posing a risk to payment processing services and sensitive financial data.
Author: Z User
Message:
Phase A Section 4: Secret detection (known patterns + entropy)

SecurityAgent had no deterministic secret scanner — only LLM-based auth
review that missed secrets the LLM didn't notice. This adds real secret
detection with both known-pattern matching + entropy-based detection.

server/src/security/secret-patterns.ts (NEW):
  - KNOWN_PATTERNS: 5 patterns extracted from CodeReviewAgent (keyword-secret,
    aws-access-key, github-pat, jwt-bearer, private-key-block) — shared
    module prevents drift between write-time gate + periodic scanner
  - detectSecrets(filePath, content): combines known patterns + entropy
  - Entropy: Shannon entropy >= 4.5 + length >= 20, excludes UUIDs/hex-
    hashes/data-URIs/file-paths/URLs. Catches custom API keys (Stripe,
    Slack, generic) that don't match known prefixes
  - Returns SecretFinding[] with matchType: 'known-pattern' (high) vs
    'entropy' (medium) — distinguishes confidence levels
  - scanCodebaseForSecrets(projectRoot, targetDir): recursive scanner,
    excludes node_modules/dist/.git/tests/coverage/.traces/.runtime + .env

server/src/agents/code-review/index.ts:
  - Refactored to import KNOWN_PATTERNS from shared module (no inline drift)
  - Entropy NOT added to write-time gate (per Section 0 — false-positive risk)

server/src/agents/security/index.ts:
  - New scanSecrets(projectRoot, targetDir) on-demand method

server/src/orchestration/ghost-scanners.ts:
  - New secretScanner() at 30s cadence, type='security:secret'

server/src/orchestration/ghost-mode.ts:
  - planFix() dispatches security:secret → suggest-only (human reviews + rotates)

Tests (21 new in tests/unit/secret-detection.test.ts):
  - Known patterns: AWS, GitHub PAT (ghp_ + github_pat_), JWT, keyword, PEM
  - Entropy: custom high-entropy keys caught with matchType=entropy
  - False positives: UUID, SHA-256, data URI, short strings, English text
  - SecurityAgent.scanSecrets() on-demand method
  - Ghost Mode periodic scanner + suggest-only planning
  - Entropy helpers verified

Total: 669 tests passing (648 original + 21 new), 0 failures.
Typecheck clean. grep-audit clean.

Scope guards: no entropy at write-time, no .env scanning, no auto-remediation.
